title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - VirtualMachineServiceOffering
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/VirtualMachineServiceOffering. A digital service available for order and offering computational capabilities. Subclass of ComputeServiceOffering per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the ComputeServiceOffering model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'VirtualMachineServiceOffering'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

codeArtifact.description: Relationship. Compute service code artifacts. Links to one or more VMImage entities.

instantiationReq.description: Relationship. Set of technical requirements or conditions to instantiate this service offering. Links to one or more ServerFlavor entities.
